provenance.method: The three Probes (Sensitive, Typical, Cautious) with their calibrated weights, sector-wide BLS, light-curve vetting and the limb-darkened fit, on each star's first SPOC 2-minute sector, as in the benchmark report; every consensus event on the real and control curves. No FAP rule. Restricted to the Sentinels' 40-star subsample, to compare like with like. Sentinels run on Claude (Anthropic). Probes are deterministic matched-filter detectors.
